senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to be still,] to hear, listen, obey; to understand.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 4:2">R. Hash. IV, 2</cite> <he>כל עיר … ושׁוֹמַעַת וכ׳</he> every township near Jerusalem from where you can see (the city) and hear (the Shofar) &c.
Ib. 21ᵇ עד שיִשְׁמְעוּ … מקודש until they heard from the mouth of the court m’ḳuddash (v. קָרַשׁ).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90a:10">Snh. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁמַע לו</he> listen to him (obey the prophet’s command); <he>אל תִּשְׁמַע לו</he> listen not to him.
<cite ref="Ketubot 5b:2">Keth. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>אם יִשְׁמַע וכ׳</he> if a man hears an improper word &c., v. <cite ref="U01736"><he>שָׁפָה</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:34">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> the text (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:4">Deut. VI, 4</cite>) says ‘hear’ (or ‘understand’), <he>בכל לשון שאתה שׁוֹמֵעַ</he> recite the Sh’mʿa in whatever language you understand.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 3:7">R. Hash. III, 7</cite> <he>אם קול שופר ש׳</he> if he heard the sound of a Shofar; <he>ואם קול הברה ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00053"><he>הֲבָרָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 1:2:6">Y. Hor. I, 46ᵃ</cite> top <he>נותנין לו שהות עד שׁיִשְׁמַע</he> we allow him time enough that he may have heard (the decision of the other court), opp. to <he>עד שישמע</he> (not <he>שישפע</he>) (he is not guilty) until he has really heard it; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to hear; to announce. Ber. l. c. הַשְׁמַע לאזניך וכ׳ let thy ears hear what thou utterest &c. Ib. לא ה׳ לאזנו if he read the Sh’inʿa inaudibly to himself.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28b:6">R. Hash. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שיתכוין שומע ומַשְׁמִיעַ</he> until he that hears (the Shofar) and he that causes to hear (that blows) have the intention to perform a religious act.
Shek. I, 1 מַשְׁמִיעִין על השקלים וכ׳ (Y. ed. מְשַׁמְּעִין, Pi.) public announcement is made concerning the contribution of the half-Shekels &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (sub. עצמו) to show one’s self obedient, be persuaded, surrender, v. Nif.
to announce, v. supra. Y. Shek. I, beg. 45ᶜ; Y. Meg. I, 71ᵃ.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 47a:6">Snh. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>הלינו לכבודו לשַׁמֵּעַ עליו וכ׳</he> if burial is postponed for the honor of the dead, to assemble the surrounding townships for his funeral, to bring on lamenting women &c.

senses.gloss: to be heard; to be listened to, be obeyed.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6a:22">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>אין תפלה … נִשְׁמַעַת וכ׳</he> man’s prayer is heard only in the house of prayer. Y. ib. V, end, 9ᵇ <he>שׁנִשְׁמְעָה תפלתו</he> that his prayer will be heard (his petition be granted).
<cite ref="Eruvin 18b:16">Erub. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>כל בית שׁנִשְׁמָעִין וכ׳</he> a house in which the words of the Law are heard by night will never be destroyed.

<cite ref="Yevamot 65b:6">Yeb. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>כשם … דבר הנִשְׁמָע וכ׳</he> as well as it is proper to say a thing that has been heard (to mention one’s authority), so it is proper not to say a thing that has not been heard (for which you cannot cite your authority); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to show one’s self willing; to submit to authority; (of woman) to surrender.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25b:4">R. Hash. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אשרי הדור שהגדולים נִשְׁמָעִים וכ׳</he> blessed the generation in which the superiors (in wisdom) submit to the authority of their inferiors, and how much more when inferiors acknowledge the authority of their superiors!—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:11">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>הִשָּׁמְעִי לי</he> (ed. <he>הַשְׁמִיעִי לי</he>) surrender thyself to me; <he>לא תִשָּׁמְעִי אלא וכ׳</he> surrender thyself only to a prominent man among them; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">ib.</cite> <he>רצונך שׁאֶשָּׁמַע לך הנזר וכ׳</he> if thou desirest me to surrender myself to thee, renounce the law of Moses; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 771:1">Yalk. ib. 771</cite>. Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ top <he>נִשְׁמָעוֹת … לליגיונותי וכ׳</he> if you will surrender to my legions, I will not put you to death.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 93a:7">Snh. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>הַשְׁמִיעִי אל וכ׳</he> surrender thyself to Zedekiah; a. fr.
